title: Open Claim Aging Watch
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=claim:home claim_status=* days_open=*
| where claim_status!="closed" AND days_open>30
| sort - days_open
| table claim_type claim_status days_open payout_usd
description: Lists open home insurance claims that have remained unresolved for more than thirty days.
value: Stale claims often mean missing documentation or adjuster follow-up that you can nudge proactively.
implementation: Log `days_open` and `claim_status` on every claim event and review the aging queue weekly during repairs.
visualization: Table of open claims ranked by days open.
grandmaExplanation: It watches home insurance claims that have dragged on more than a month without closing.
